#WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life. What if your ideas could change the way the world connects, powers up, or thinks? As a Junior Software Engineer in our Research & Development team, you'll have the opportunity to merge creativity with your technical expertise by shaping the future of technology, driving groundbreaking projects, and bringing new ideas to life. Are you in?
Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role
In this role, you will combine technical expertise with a strong grasp of modern DevOps practices to deliver scalable, high-quality software solutions.
Design, build and run a web application and platform based on Angular and NestJS that drives Infineon's digitalization journey for product portfolio and roadmap management
Collaborate with developers, architects, business analysts, UX experts and business stakeholders to design and build maintainable and scalable solutions, while developing your software design and architecture skills
Work in cross-functional Scrum teams and follow DevOps practices and methods
Contribute across the software lifecycle, including implementation, testing, CI/CD, deployment and operation
Continuously learn, experiment with and evaluate new engineering practices and technologies, including AI-assisted development, and apply useful approaches in your daily work
 Your profile
 Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed
 You bring a strong engineering mindset, curiosity and openness to feedback. You care about understanding how and why software works, not only about making it work, and you are motivated to continuously improve your technical skills and the solutions you build.
University degree in Computer Science, Informatics or in a related field 
1–3 years of hands-on software development experience, with meaningful experience across both frontend and backend development
Good knowledge of TypeScript and hands-on experience building modern web frontends using Angular, React or comparable frameworks
Hands-on backend development experience, with a good foundation in software design, API design, application structure, relational databases, data modelling. Experience with NestJS is beneficial
A strong engineering and problem-solving mindset, with the ability to learn and adapt, seek feedback and take increasing ownership of solutions
Experience with Git, automated testing and modern software delivery practices. Exposure to CI/CD, cloud technologies, containers, Kubernetes or OpenShift is beneficial
Fluency in English (mandatory)
 Please send us your CV in English.
